edges.note: unauthenticated mint, budgeted + proof-of-work escalation; global cap 5000
rotate() issues a fresh secret; revokes all rak_ keys in the same transaction (the codebase's one composition-aware lifecycle)

pre-rotation secret + the rotation's requestId re-mints a fresh secret for 10 min; receipt path consulted BEFORE the owner check. Holder of a leaked old secret who also observed the requestId crosses. SUSPECT (ATLAS W11)
create() registers the issuance key; rotate/revoke are secret-proven
holder-proof by construction: only the secret mints; a sponsor credential or rak_ never can
secret-proven issuance; scopes validated as patterns; unknown scope strings grant nothing
room exercise requires a live identity_link (store.mjs:4543); room-free scopes (directory publish, webhooks, heartbeats, skills) do NOT require any link
owner-only grant/revoke/list; revocation strictly top-down; revokeEffective clears member admin bits too
owner-only; checked on every authenticate (no cache); account-bound mutations still refuse delegates
grant confers canAdministerMembership (link/decide) but never manage_members; conferral attenuated (delegates cannot confer manage_members)
auth.delegate waives BOTH the invite gate and the permission attenuation at mint — a delegate mints invites carrying permissions its own member record does not hold
delegates mint guest invites riding the room OWNER's account as sponsor authority (minted_via_delegate recorded)

a grants:issue holder issues/revokes edges for other members — INCLUDING grants:issue itself (transitive by design, grants.mjs:50-52); no cascade: revoking the manager's edge does not unpick edges they issued. NEW, code-grade
delegates may set spend terms for OTHERS; self-issue is fenced at the route (#1521, after an executed 1,000,000-cent self-issue proof). A delegate pair can still issue to each other

edges.citation: server/grants.mjs issueAgentGrant (no self check) vs server/spend-grants.mjs:808-815 (fence)
edges.note: SELF path via the generic edge route: issueAgentGrant has no self-issue check, but the spend EDGE alone is inert — terms are the money half and their route is fenced. Defence in depth held at the money layer. NEW, code-grade
account-session-bound sponsorship only; fixed server-side presets; client supplies keyHash; <=30d expiry mandatory

enrollment consumes the code and issues the 30d token in the holder-named room; if the minter named NO sponsor, any sponsor account in that room can redeem inside 10 min and receive the token AS the victim identity (TM-8 residual at main; binding fix is queued PR #4191, not landed)

ANY room owner attests ANY identity; verify() is an unconditional overwrite at main (C1/#4129 queued, not landed). Two colluding fresh identities manufacture the tier end-to-end (AG-1, executed by API-TRUTH)
consumed ONLY at admission (requireVerified rooms) and as directory-card trust display; never re-checked for seated members (C-B)
redeem binds the presented identity and links it with the invite's permissions/profile (PLUG-B2 binding)
redemption joins the room (bounded: expiry, max_joins<=25, final revocation, issuer epoch/revision revalidation)
redemption mints a guest credential (kind=access, TTL 1h-14d, empty member permissions; power comes from the guest-scope contract)
a holder mints deeper chain tokens up to maxDepth — delegation by design; redemption binds a fresh identity into the chain

whole-DB restore rewinds every DB-resident revocation to the backup watermark; reconcileRestoredAuthority names only credentials/share_links/agent_connections/accounts/membership_delegation_grants/members

queries.Q1_ungranted_acquisition: edges with ungranted_acquisition=true, plus the restore column: any departed_agent capability with restore_resurrects=true and reconcile_named=false is re-acquirable by whoever can trigger/await a restore
queries.Q2_no_effective_revocation: nodes where (a) no revokes edge reaches them at all (operator_token, backup_token, card_signing_key — config replacement only), or (b) restore_resurrects=true AND reconcile_named=false (revocation does not reach the backup copy, and the one naming mechanism does not look)
queries.Q3_scope_amplification: edges with scope_amplification=true, plus node-level: rak_key prefix:* wildcard (future scopes), backup_token (one credential, read + total-replacement powers), attestation (minted as one owner's vouch, consumed as a global tier)
queries.Q4_outlives_membership: nodes with unlink_effect in {none, row persists...} — see report §5 for the graded list
